decisions.final: OWNER_IS_CREDITOR keeps tenant AR in operational subledger; OFFICE_IS_CREDITOR posts Tenant Receivable to GL.
RATE recognizes on collection; FIXED_MONTHLY accrues daily over service period.
Brokerage on signed contract activation; renewal on renewal activation; setup on accepted handover; advance cash is deferred revenue.
Owner expense is Due from Owner. Offset only when agreement grants it; order is owner expenses, fees/tax, reserve, payout.
Deposit remains liability. Application requires approved claim/invoice, evidence, allocation and atomic transaction; reversal is compensating transaction.
Monthly OPEN/SOFT_CLOSED/HARD_CLOSED; hard close irreversible; late events post to first open period preserving effective date.
Separate principal module with ROU asset and lease liability; implicit rate else IBR snapshot; standard modification and short-term election rules.
No hard-coded statutory rate. Versioned company tax codes; each line snapshots code/rate/amount; taxable posting blocked if profile incomplete.
Disabled by default; explicit contract term, grace period and cap; no compounding; server calculated; waiver requires permission and reason.
Approved termination record; future schedule cancelled not deleted; accrued amounts retained; charge defaults to none unless explicit formula.
Maker-checker by default; creator cannot final approve material contract; required signatures/evidence before activation; audited sole-admin exception.
Core seven-step workflow with property-type templates; only admin evidence-backed waivers; identity and safety gates non-waivable.
No silent retroactive mutation. Material changes create amendment/version; historical correction uses catch-up/reversal.
Inputs reserved atomically; no item in two active settlements; rederive before approval/payment; post-payment refund creates Due from Owner.
Posted invoices and financial records are never deleted; use credit note, void and reversal; cash refund includes payment-out event.
Preview and fail-closed import; any invalid or ambiguous row blocks batch; no silent partial success; server limits/counts and OMR 3dp.
Read-only analysis first, then company/period/source-scoped append-only correction batches with before/after evidence and approval.
One stage per PR from latest main; agent may mark only agent checklist; reviewer ledger is owner-protected; no stage complete without both.
